title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I didn’t get the job. I’m fucking devastated but I dont gotta go to work tonight so have fun out there

Fuck man, I’m really sorry to hear that. Thought you were a great candidate for it. Lemme know if you need something or want to get together soon. I’m not sure I’m full of wisdom and advice but I know what it feels like to work your ass off for something and have it denied. It feels like a guy punch
